details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B) The orchestrator poller and stall recovery (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C) The clarify → plan → implement issue pipeline
D) Documentation only (README.md, agents.md fragments, docs/)
E) Other: name the specific file, workflow or behaviour (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for this change?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure (link the failing run, issue or PR) (RECOMMENDED)
B) Make it faster or cut cost (fewer API calls or model tokens)
C) Make it more reliable (fewer retries, stalls or human escalations)
D) Make it clearer (logs, alerts or docs)
E) Other: describe the observable outcome you expect after the change
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A) You will give a concrete check: a failing test, a log line, or a run that should succeed (RECOMMENDED)
B) A new contract test that pins the new behaviour, written as part of this issue
C) No measurable check; review the change by reading it
**Note:** C combined with Q2:B or Q2:C cannot be verified, and planning would ask again.
